newsitem.title: INDIA: Five killed in gunbattle in Kashmir.
newsitem.headline: Five killed in gunbattle in Kashmir.

text.p: Three separatist guerrillas and two Indian soldiers were killed in a gunbattle in troubled Jammu and Kashmir state near the Pakistan border, a police spokesman said on Tuesday.
They said the guerrillas and paramilitary personnel were killed late on Monday in the thick forests of Michil sector.
Michil sector in Kupwara town lies near the India-Pakistan border, 85 km (53 miles) north of Srinagar, the summer capital of Jammu and Kashmir.
Earlier this month Indian security forces shot dead 13 separatist guerrillas near the border.

In another incident on Monday evening, nine people including two paramilitary personnel were injured when suspected guerrillas lobbed a grenade on a security patrol vehicle at Behama Chowk on the outskirts of Srinagar, police said.
They said the grenade missed the intended target and exploded on the road, wounding seven pedestrians and two paramilitary personnel.
More than a dozen guerrilla groups are fighting New Delhi's rule in Jammu and Kashmir, India's only Moslem majority state.
Police and hospitals say more than 20,000 people have been killed in a seven-year-old rebellion in the Himalayan region.
